metadata.description: Captured GET /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/device-status — real 404 error response. Hand-authored from a raw curl capture (not via bin/mock-capture, which log.Fatal-exits on non-2xx status before writing a fixture) because the test org group has zero device-update deployments across every update UUID sampled (12 of 75 updates checked via GET .../deployments, all 204 No Content), so this endpoint cannot return a 200 in this environment; this is the genuine, unmutated live-server response (26.4 test tenant, 2026-08-07), not a fabricated shape. Matches the 26.2 reference fixture's shape exactly (errorCode 5223, same message template, same activityId-as-uuid field).
